description: Read a payout the agent held for approval by approval_id: awaiting_approval while it is pending; approved with the agent_approval { id, role } to pass to record_release; rejected with the approver's reason; or expired once its release-by date passed undecided. Each decision is signed and chained to the agent's decision record. Do not release a payout while it is awaiting approval, rejected or expired. Read-only. Needs the organisation's key; demo items (aprd_) do not.

approval_id.description: apr_… (or aprd_… for a demo item), from POST /api/v1/agent/run with policy_id.
